assessments.reasoning: The W3C dated Recommendation URL and document heading identify XML 1.0 Fifth Edition of 26 November 2008. The independently downloaded full response SHA-256 matches the registered source revision. The EOL clause names external parsed entities, processing order, both input sequences, and the resulting character. The requirement is observable behavior as if normalized before parsing. Literal source characters and references are distinct cases. The edition and external parsed entity condition match the governing section. The section deliberately covers both paired and bare CR. A reference producing a CR after parsing begins is a different input case.
